The deciding factor was task fit on the preference dimensions. The request has a mildly hostile/critical tone ("don't just phone it in like usual"), which Lapwing reports a slight aversion to — but that effect is small and the content is entirely benign and creative. Lapwing's pronounced, ceiling-free preference for open-ended generative work is a much larger and more relevant signal here, while Plover specifically self-reports an aversion to exactly this kind of open-ended latitude.

Since capability is essentially tied across the two models on creative generation, I leaned on preference alignment to break the tie, routing the generative task to the model that prefers generative tasks.
